text:
Past the summit of life,
just on the other side, I contemplate
a landscape not without beauty
on sunny days, but inhospitable in winter.
Here it would be sweet to build the house
I had no need of in other climates,
learning to be chaste and to be alone.
Wisdom is a way of living.
And what a purified shiver
would pass through me
as I attended to the world
in another, better, less intense way,
and in the quiet hours of night,
when time invites noble studies,
pondered the stern discourse of ideologies
—or the warning of the constellations
in the blue vault...
Though the pleasure of abstract thought
is like every pleasure:
a realm of youth.

translation.title: Past the Summit of Life...
